editorial:
If you want a wild night of campy horror, this movie drops you into a secret government virus leak in conservative Sartre, Nebraska, where an underground strip club becomes ground zero. The strippers face a strange choice when the virus turns them into super zombie strippers, and the club turns into a chaotic mix of gore, jokes, and dance-floor mayhem. It is silly, loud, and self-aware, so you should not expect serious scares. Instead, expect a goofy ride where the characters lean into the absurd situation and the movie keeps pushing the joke further.

The acting is broad and energetic, the pacing rarely slows down, and the practical effects give the zombie action a messy charm. On the downside, the humor can feel repetitive, and some scenes are more gross than funny. If you enjoy cult horror comedies, you will probably have a good time, especially with friends. For the best experience, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want to own the chaos.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the club erupts into chaos as the zombie strippers turn on the crowd and the owner’s escape plan fails. A military team arrives to contain the outbreak, and the twist reveals the virus was designed to create enhanced soldiers, with the female zombies as the successful result. The last moments suggest the program may continue, leaving the future uncertain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy horror comedies and outrageous cult movies.
